name: moin-ai
description: Manage a moinAI customer service chatbot from Claude. Connects to the moinAI MCP server (https://api.moin.ai/mcp) to create and configure AI agents, write knowledge documents, attach websites and PDFs as knowledge, wire up webhook integrations as AI actions, build answer templates such as product sliders, edit the basic conversation elements, set up the widget design and channel use case for new bots, and test answers in the playground. Ships the bot-management playbook as a skill, so Claude knows the staging/live model and the end-to-end workflows. Content changes are confined to staging; live-effective settings only on bots that are not productive yet. Requires a moinAI account; authenticates with your Hub login over OAuth.
